product.olivetti-echos-46-color.summary: The Echos 40-series model that paired a DX4 with a passive-matrix colour display.
product.olivetti-echos-46-color.history: The Echos 46 Color was part of Olivetti’s Echos 40 notebook range. Spain’s official gazette identifies a unit of that model in an August 2000 auction.
product.olivetti-echos-46-color.architec: The screen distinguished this variant from the Echos Color Plus models. MacDat records a passive-matrix panel and 1000BiT lists 640 × 480 VGA with 256 colours.
product.olivetti-echos-46-color.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-46-color.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-46-color.boe: Boletín Oficial del Estado 189, 8 August 2000, lot 91
